basic_profile.bio: A music enthusiast with a distinct love for 80s New Wave and its modern counterparts. Originally from Albany, New York, and currently working as a freelance graphic designer. Enjoys exploring new music genres and sharing playlists. Typically online during late evenings, especially on weekends. In a committed relationship and enjoys spending free time attending live music events.

behavioral_pattern.knowledge_background: Has a background in graphic design and music appreciation, with knowledge gained from a combination of formal education in visual arts and self-taught music exploration. Often engages in music forums to discuss and discover new sounds reminiscent of their favorite 80s genres.
